description: This file contains a function 'makeWakeWordSegments' that processes transcript words and their timing information to produce an array of WakeWordSegment objects. It imports Foundation and SwabbleKit frameworks.

classes.name: WakeWordSegment
classes.description: A data structure representing a segment of wake word with text, timing, and range information.

methods.name: makeWakeWordSegments
methods.description: Creates an array of WakeWordSegment objects from transcript text and associated words with timing details.
